sources.snippet: CoCA This is an official implementation of "Step-level Reward for Free in RL-based T2I Diffusion Model Fine-tuning". CoCA is a contribution-based credit assignment algorithm that transforms trajectory-level rewards into step-level rewards at no additional cost in RL fine-tuning of T2I diffusion models.
